lead.headline: Bastion secures conditional OCC trust charter, opening federally regulated stablecoin custody and payments
lead.tldr: Federal banking regulators are now conditionally chartering crypto-native trust banks while agencies like CFTC bypass Congress on rulemaking, creating a two-speed regulatory environment where compliant infrastructure players gain structural advantage over token markets still awaiting legislative clarity.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's signals show federal regulators building crypto banking rails through administrative action while Congress stalls, and we need to track which model wins.

top_signals.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter25m, Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charterBastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.
top_signals.summary: Bastion Platforms has received conditional approval from the OCC for a national trust bank charter. This allows the company to provide federally regulated stablecoin custody, wallets, and payment infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bastion's conditional OCC charter matters because it creates a federally supervised on-ramp for stablecoin custody and white-label issuance that traditional treasury clients can underwrite against, separating compliant infrastructure from the unregulated wallet crowd.

top_signals.title: CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has submitted its crypto asset rulemaking to the White House for review. This move indicates the agency is proceeding with regulatory frameworks independently of Congressional action.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The CFTC's unilateral rulemaking push matters because it signals commodity regulators will define crypto derivatives markets before Congress acts, creating compliance costs that favor incumbents with existing CFTC relationships over new entrants.

top_signals.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase with filing for US stock perpetual futures
top_signals.summary: Kalshi has filed plans to introduce perpetual futures for large-cap US stocks, integrating with Coinbase. These contracts will allow for 24/7 trading of stock-based assets without expiration dates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kalshi's stock perpetual futures filing matters because it tests whether tokenized equity derivatives can capture 24/7 demand without SEC jurisdiction, with Coinbase integration offering distribution that could reprice how we value traditional equity market infrastructure.

top_signals.title: View latest issue, Winning on Robinhood Chain?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the implications and potential of the Robinhood Chain. It explores how the platform's integration into the crypto ecosystem could impact user adoption and market dynamics.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Robinhood Chain discussion matters because Robinhood's captive retail user base could become the largest crypto onboarding channel in the US, and any founder building consumer DeFi needs to underwrite their distribution power.

top_signals.title: Dtcpay welcomes SBI Group as strategic investor extending Series A to $25M
top_signals.summary: Singapore-based stablecoin payments firm Dtcpay has completed its Series A funding round, totaling $25 million. The round saw the addition of SBI Group as a strategic investor.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SBI Group's extension of Dtcpay's Series A to $25M matters because Japanese megabank investment in Singapore stablecoin payments confirms Asia-Pacific as the live corridor for regulated stablecoin settlement, with US players structurally excluded by uncertainty.

deals.summary: Singapore-based stablecoin payments firm Dtcpay has completed its Series A funding round, totaling $25 million. The round saw the addition of SBI Group as a strategic investor.

on_the_radar.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive38m
on_the_radar.summary: REX has launched a 2x leveraged ETF that tracks the performance of Strive, a firm known for its Bitcoin treasury strategy. This product allows investors to gain amplified exposure to Bitcoin through a corporate treasury vehicle.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin ETFs eke out positive week with $433 million Friday inflow as ether funds snap four-week inflow streak
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw a positive weekly performance driven by a $433 million net inflow on Friday. In contrast, Ethereum funds experienced a break in their four-week inflow streak.

on_the_radar.title: Visa to close Crossmint memecoin rewards loophole following The Block investigation: report
on_the_radar.summary: Visa is reportedly moving to close a rewards loophole involving Crossmint-powered memecoin sales following an investigation by The Block. While sales remain active for now, a grace period is expected to end next week.

on_the_radar.title: Hong Kong jails former banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
on_the_radar.summary: A former bank official in Hong Kong has been sentenced to four years in prison for accepting cryptocurrency bribes. The bribes were paid in exchange for falsifying letters of credit totaling $1.6 billion.

on_the_radar.title: Weekly Research Brief: Clarity Without the Clarity Act
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses the failure of the Clarity Act and the SEC's subsequent pursuit of an innovation exemption. It also touches upon the intersection of AI and regulatory pacing.

on_the_radar.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment7m, Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitmentBinance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance has dismissed speculation regarding European Central Bank intervention in its Greek MiCA application. The exchange reaffirmed its commitment to obtaining regulatory authorization across Europe.

on_the_radar.title: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
on_the_radar.summary: Zcash developers have targeted November 5 for the activation of the NU7 mainnet upgrade. The update will introduce 25-second block times and integrate Network Signaling Mechanism (NSM) functionality.

linkedin_post:
The OCC handed Bastion a conditional national trust charter yesterday. Not a no-action letter. A charter. Federally regulated stablecoin custody, wallets, white-label issuance, payment infrastructure—one entity, one examiner, one set of capital requirements.

This is not speculative. This is the architecture for how dollar-backed tokens settle in US banking rails.

Meanwhile the CFTC shipped its crypto rulemaking to the White House this week, bypassing Congress entirely. Two agencies, two speeds. The CFTC is building fences around derivatives markets. The OCC is chartering the banks that will clear the underlying. Neither is waiting for the CLARITY Act.

We underwrite infrastructure on regulatory durability. Bastion's charter is durable. Kalshi's stock perpetuals on Coinbase—less clear. The SEC has not spoken on whether equity-linked perps fall under its remit, and the CFTC's enthusiasm for asserting jurisdiction does not guarantee it keeps it.

What kills this thesis: a court overturns the OCC's authority to charter non-depository trust banks for crypto, or the Fed refuses master account access to Bastion's deposits. What confirms it: a second OCC charter to a competitor, or a major bank announcing stablecoin custody through Bastion's rails.

SBI Group put money into Dtcpay's Series A extension. They are not confused about where the payments corridor is forming. Singapore, not San Francisco. We have been tracking Dtcpay since early 2023. The Asia-Pacific stablecoin settlement thesis is now funded by Japanese megabanks.

US founders should look hard at what they cannot build here.
